notes: Bureau of Reclamation 'June 2025 Most Probable 24-Month Study' (20 pages as served, landscape letter, Word-generated with Acrobat PDFMaker 25, tagged; Last-Modified June 17, 2025; footer date June 17, 2025), cut to pages 1-15 with pypdf. Page 1: banner ('U.S. Department of the Interior / Bureau of Reclamation / Upper and Lower Colorado Basin Regions', the title, logo image), five paragraphs and two footnotes; page 2: four paragraphs, the 'References' heading and seven label lines each followed by a URL; pages 3-15: one table per page, in this order: Fontenelle, Flaming Gorge, Taylor Park, Blue Mesa, Morrow Point, Crystal, Vallecito and Navajo Reservoirs, Lake Powell, Hoover Dam - Lake Mead, Davis Dam - Lake Mohave, Parker Dam - Lake Havasu, and Hoover Dam - Lake Mead again (power: release, head, generation capacity, gross energy). Page 16 starts the next table (Davis Dam - Lake Mohave, power), so 15 is the largest k of at most 15 at whose end a table ends. Headings: only 'References' is listed. The page-1 title contains '24-Month' (hyphen code point unseen) and is not checked; the reservoir names and the repeated title block of the table pages are table titles (captions), not headings, as in the earlier sets; the reservoir names are must_contain phrases instead (each printed once in the kept pages; 'Lake Mohave' and 'Lake Havasu' as the distinctive part of their titles, whose dash cannot be seen). Tables: two of the thirteen are transcribed, both complete: Lake Powell (page 11) and Hoover Dam - Lake Mead (page 12); the other eleven tables are not checked (their titles are). Header cells printed on two or three lines are written joined with single spaces ('Reservoir Elevation End of Month (Ft)'); the hyphen in 'Ac-Ft' is written as ASCII hyphen-minus (assumed). Bold 'WY 2024/2025/2026' rows leave the elevation, bank storage and storage columns (Powell) and the CFS, bank storage, elevation and storage columns (Mead) empty (empty strings, not scored); the grey shading of the historical rows (Jun 2024 - May 2025) is not checked. Arithmetic checked while typing (a throwaway script): Lake Mead 'Glen Release' equals Lake Powell 'Total Release' in all 39 rows; Powell total release = power plant + bypass release in 36 of 39 rows (Aug, Sep and Oct 2024 differ by 1, the publication's rounding; re-read at 300 dpi); WY 2025 and WY 2026 totals = sums of their 12 months in every summed column within 1, except Mead WY 2025 evaporation (471 summed, 473 printed) and Powell WY 2026 regulated inflow (7812 summed, 7810 printed), both re-read at 300 dpi and kept as printed; month-to-month storage change = inflow - evaporation - release (- SNWP use) - bank storage change within 2 for every month but Mead Jan 2025 (3, historical data, re-read and kept); Mead release in 1000 CFS = release / (1.98347 x days in month) within 0.06 for every month. must_contain: 46 items, each printed once in the kept pages, none crossing a page break: 20 from page 1 (including the banner line and both footnotes), 16 from page 2 (one is a reference URL) and the 10 reservoir titles of pages 3-10, 13 and 14. Phrases avoid every hyphen ('24-Month', 'Mid-Elevation', '30-year', 'acre-feet', 'Near-term'), the apostrophes ('Service's', 'Hoover's', 'Region's') and the superscript footnote marks. ordered: 8 anchors on pages 1 (three; the last from footnote 1), 2, 3, 9, 11 (the first elevation cell of Lake Powell, '3585.60', which no other kept table prints) and 13. Noise: the footer date 'June 17, 2025' is printed on pages 1 and 2 and nowhere in the body, max 1 (one kept copy is tolerated); the italic footer title repeats the page-1 title and is not counted (hyphen), page numbers are too short, and the table pages' title block and 'Model Run ID: 3285 / Processed on: 6/10/2025 1:39:27 PM' line are part of each table page, not counted. Absent: the narrative is ragged-right with no line-end hyphenation, so absent is empty. BLIND PROTOCOL: chosen and answered before any converter or text extractor was run on the file; every check was typed from the rendered pages (pdftoppm at 70-300 dpi, read as images), and the PDF text layer was never read. Consequences: (1) text that may be an image (logos, seals, signatures, chart art) is not checked; (2) invisible text-layer content cannot be known, so noise lists only VISIBLE repeated page furniture; (3) where the exact code point of a glyph cannot be seen (curly vs straight quotes, dash and minus variants), must_contain phrases and ordered anchors avoid it; headings, table cells and absent entries that cannot avoid it are noted per file.
